newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Oct 31.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Oct 31.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Henri Konan Bedie receives chiefs of delegations attending his ruling Democratic Party's congress.

- Abidjan Port Authority says in advertisement it has started implementing strict regulations on dates for loading of export containers on ships; asks exporters to check closing dates for loading of individual ships with local agents.

- Opposition leader Laurent Gbagbo of Ivorian Popular Front party to address his followers on Saturday and reply to keynote address given by President Bedie at congress of the ruling Democratic Party.
- Staff of multi-national airliner Air Afrique are opposed to another expatriate chief executive. Staff pressure forced the the termination of contract of Frenchman Yves Roland Bilecart.
- Opposition lawyer says 104 opposition actvists still in detention in Abidjan and central town of Gagnoa since their arrest over political violence surrounding presidential elections a year ago.
